item.title: Draft Notice Amendment on Forest-Absorption J-Credits for Greenhouse Gas Reporting
item.description: AI summary: The proposed Notice amendment would add an entity's own efforts to preserve and enhance greenhouse gas absorption through forest management and conservation to the J-Credit scheme definition in item 4 of the domestic certified emission reductions notice. It would amend Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry and Ministry of the Environment Notice No. 3 of March 2010, supporting reporting by specified emitters under the Act on Promotion of Global Warming Countermeasures (Act No. 117 of 1998). The explanatory document states that related instruments already provide for using forest-absorption credits from an entity's own efforts to adjust its own adjusted emissions; this draft would align the credit-definition notice with those provisions. The Ministry of the Environment and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry published the draft for public comment on 2026-11-12, with a stated deadline of 2026-12-12 00:00 JST. Issuance of the Notice is planned for January 2027, with application planned from April 1, 2027; these are proposed dates, not confirmed implementation. Original title: 「温室効果ガス算定排出量等の報告等に関する命令第一条第五号に規定する環境大臣及び経済産業大臣が定める国内認証排出削減量の一部を改正する件（案）」に対する意見募集について Public Comment Open | e-Gov Public Comment | Published 2026-11-12 | First detected 2026-11-12 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. Original Japanese official sources remain authoritative.

item.title: Draft Notice amending greenhouse gas reporting calculations for forest-related domestic credits
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of the Environment and the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry proposed amending their Notice No. 2 of 2025 on greenhouse gas reporting calculation methods. The draft would expand the definition of making domestic certified emission reductions non-transferable for emissions adjustment to include credits from a reporting entity's own forest management and conservation activities that preserve or enhance greenhouse gas absorption; the definition also covers other parties' emission-reduction activities. It concerns specified emitters reporting under the Act on Promotion of Global Warming Countermeasures, Act No. 117 of 1998, and Articles 4(5) and 13(3) of the greenhouse gas emissions reporting Ministerial Ordinance. The draft was published for public comment on 2026-11-12, with a stated deadline of 2026-12-12 00:00 JST. The outline schedules publication of the Notice for January 2027 and application from April 1, 2027; these are proposed dates, not confirmation of promulgation or application. item.title: Public consultation on draft recommendations for endangered species conservation
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of the Environment announced a public consultation on draft recommendations for endangered wild fauna and flora conservation on 2026-11-12, with a stated comment period of November 12 to December 11, 2026. The draft addresses habitat conservation, avoidance and reduction of development impacts, conservation partnerships with private actors, stronger national-local government coordination, and adjustments to transfer-related regulation. It follows a statutory review of an amending Act that took effect in June 2018 and discussions by the Central Environment Council's Wildlife Subcommittee. The announcement also links the review to the December 2025 mega-solar policy package, including promotion of habitat protection areas and consideration of effective responses to development affecting rare species; these are draft recommendations, not enacted changes. item.title: Ministerial environmental opinion on proposed Shimouke-Matsubara pumped-storage power plant
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of the Environment announced on 2026-11-06 the submission of the Environment Minister's opinion on the planning-stage environmental consideration document for the proposed Shimouke-Matsubara pumped-storage power plant. Kyushu Electric Power Co., Inc. proposes a roughly 100,000 kW plant using existing power-generation water-storage capacity at Shimouke and Matsubara dams in Hita, Oita Prefecture, and Oguni, Kumamoto Prefecture. The opinion raises concerns about site selection involving protected forests, designated sediment and landslide hazard areas, parts of Yaba-Hita-Hikosan Quasi-National Park, and important habitats, including those of mountain hawk-eagles and peregrine falcons. It calls for subsequent assessment documents to explain how the project area is narrowed down, and for surveys, impact assessment and layout planning to address sediment runoff, land disturbance and ecological impacts. This is a project-specific environmental assessment opinion, not an announcement of project approval or a legislative amendment. Original title: （仮称）下筌・松原揚水発電所新設計画に係る計画段階環境配慮書に対する環境大臣意見の提出について Government Announcement | Ministry of the Environment (MOE) | Published 2026-11-06 | First detected 2026-11-07 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation. item.title: MLIT announces eight housing-environment model projects selected in second FY2026 round
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-06, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism announced eight projects selected in the second FY2026 round of its housing-environment model program supporting a 100-year lifespan society. The program supports pioneering projects by private operators and others addressing changing housing needs, including those of older people, persons with disabilities and households raising children, following expert evaluation. Four projects were selected in the issue-defined category and four in the project-development category; none were selected in the operator-proposed category. Selected proposals include Genki Jirushi Co., Ltd.'s vacant-home renovation in Yokkaichi combining housing support with welfare-worker training, and Nasu Machizukuri Co., Ltd.'s conversion of a closed school in Nasushiobara into housing, employment-support and community facilities. This is a project-selection announcement, not a change to legislation. Original title: 誰もが安心して健康に暮らせるための先導的な取組を選定しました！ ～人生100年時代を支える住まい環境整備モデル事業選定結果（令和８年度第２回）～ Government Announcement | Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) | Published 2026-11-06 | First detected 2026-11-07 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation.
